build_tglf_transport_model: build a TGLFTransportModel instance with a custom TGLF executable path and output directory
build_tglf_transport_model_config: build a TGLFTransportModelConfig with custom kygrid_model, sat_rule, and geometry_flag settings
run_tglf_transport_simulation: run a TGLF transport simulation by calling call_implementation with geometry, core profiles, and runtime params
extract_tglf_plan: extract a TGLF input plan from TORAX physics data and runtime parameters for each radial grid cell
extract_run_data: extract turbulent transport coefficients from TGLF output flux files for electron and ion heat fluxes
